rapport_notes: Good empathetic listening on a narrow, unusual request (help fitting a wide couch up a tight stairwell); patient explaining the per-mover hourly structure.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep asked whether the couch breaks apart, asked for a detailed description of the stairwell/landing/door situation, and flagged the real risk of paying the minimum without a guaranteed fit — sustained engagement with the one concern raised, not a single question and pivot.

top_strength: Proactively flagged the real risk (paying the two-and-a-half-hour minimum only to discover on-site that the couch won't fit up the stairwell) before quoting, protecting the customer from a bad outcome instead of just taking the booking.
coaching_note: No quid pro quo framing and no agenda question were used at all — even for a short, narrow-scope call like this, a quick 'let's get you a rate, should only take a couple minutes' opener sets expectations and costs nothing to add.
